text:
Marissa - Product: @channel heads-up: we're publishing a new Data Sovereignty & Residency policy for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments. Effective 2026-06-01. TL;DR: customers must declare a region-binding for each private cluster, choose KMS locality (regional vs customer HSM), telemetry defaults to opt-in (no outbound telemetry by default), and on-prem images must include a vendor attestation signature if they want remote support. This affects Sales, CS onboarding, Legal, and Eng. Please read and act on the checklist below. :eyes:

Evan - Eng-Security: quick Q — how do we handle existing customers with mixed-region setups? any grandfathering window? :thinking_face:

Marissa - Product: short answer: 90-day grandfather window. Existing private clusters have until 2026-08-30 to declare binding. After that we'll require migration or a documented exception. We'll ship a migration helper and an "opt-in read-only fallback" mode for clusters that can't migrate immediately.

Priya - Legal: confirming: policy applies to all new Private/VPC contracts signed on/after 2026-06-01. For renewals we'll add an addendum. I'll draft standard clause language and share a template.

Samir - Customer Success: need customer-facing timeline + FAQ and a templated email for outreach. Also want a short one-pager we can hand to account owners.

jen - Sales: noted — Dedicated customers are unaffected by this (only Private/VPC/on-prem). Flagging to field enablement.

deploy-bot: Automated note: feature flag "data_residency_policy_v1" toggled ON in staging at 2026-04-12T14:30Z.

Marissa - Product: Action items (owners + deadlines):
```
- Eng (Evan) — migration-helper CLI + cluster-assessment tool — due 2026-05-15
- DevEx (Samir, jen) — onboarding docs, FAQ, sample customer email + one-pager — due 2026-05-22
- Legal (Priya) — contract addendum + renewals playbook + export-control check — due 2026-05-01
- Ops (amy.ops) — telemetry opt-in gating, metrics, and dashboard — due 2026-05-10
- Support (luis.support) — runbook for non-compliant clusters & escalation flow — due 2026-05-20
- Product (Marissa) — published internal KB + rollout schedule — due 2026-04-20
```

Evan - Eng-Security: ack. I'll open a repo and PR for the migration scripts today and schedule a weekly sync.

Samir - Customer Success: :rocket: drafting the email now, will share for review by EOD tomorrow. Also scheduling a customer webinar for migration tips.

Priya - Legal: also flagging potential export-control implications for certain regions; I'll coordinate with Security and Sales for high-risk customers.

ops-bot: Telemetry gate created: default = OFF for new Private clusters; metric "private.telemetry.opt_in_rate" added to infra dashboard.

Marissa - Product: We'll cover this in the Private product sync next Tuesday (10:00 PT). If you hit critical blockers before then, DM me. Thanks all — big cross-functional effort, please use the checklist above as source-of-truth. :thumbsup:
